ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
Both printed page markers, the complete 22 March diary body, Tolstoy's authorial footnote, and all eight notes are represented.

закон Юридический is kept as juridical law and закон положительный / положительное законодательство as positive law / positive legislation, preserving Tolstoy's own contrast with moral law rather than modernizing the terminology.

намерение ... подлежит влиянию его воли is rendered as intention being subject to the influence of a person's will; the source's rough pronoun reference is clarified only enough for grammatical English, without adding a new actor.
выгодою, приносимою преступлением is rendered benefit brought by the crime, even though the proposition is morally and doctrinally awkward; the translation does not substitute harm or gravity.
The isolated source note к is represented literally as the gloss to, and the truncated deleted Зам is conservatively represented as Rem... rather than silently completing the manuscript fragment.
